lines.description: Lines (1 to 200), each {description, origin (2 letters), qty (integer), unit_value_eur (euros), optional hs_code}, such as [{"description":"mug","origin":"CN","qty":2,"unit_value_eur":12}].

description.description: What the goods are, such as "cotton t-shirt"

hs_code.description: 6, 8 or 10 digit tariff code, dots allowed, if known (a candidate, not binding)

origin.description: 2-letter country the goods were made in, such as CN

unit_value_eur.description: Price of one unit in euros

consignment_value_eur.description: Intrinsic value of the whole consignment in euros, if different from the sum of the lines

channel.description: How the goods enter the EU: "ioss" (VAT-exempt under the Import One-Stop Shop) or "postal" (a postal consignment). The EUR 3 rule covers only "ioss" or "postal" entries (courier shipments outside IOSS are not covered; if the user says courier such as DHL without specifying IOSS, pass "ioss" to show the EUR 3 IOSS figure and state clearly that a courier entry outside IOSS is not covered and needs IOSS or postal).

description.description: Plain description of the product: what it is, what it is made of, what it is used for. Or a code, to look that code up.

country.description: Destination of the goods, whose import tariff to read: GB (United Kingdom Global Tariff) or US (Harmonized Tariff Schedule). The EU and other countries are not covered.
Two-letter country code of the VAT number: an EU member state (Greece is EL) or XI for Northern Ireland. GB numbers cannot be checked.

vatNumber.description: The business VAT registration number, as printed on an invoice, with or without the country prefix, spaces and dots, for example 811128135 or DE 811 128 135.

requesterCountry.description: Country code of the business VAT number of the user asking. Send with requesterVatNumber to get a consultation number.

requesterVatNumber.description: The business VAT number of the user asking, for a consultation number. Leave out unless the user gives it.

companies.description: Careers page URLs, "ats:slug" tokens or company names and domains, e.g. ["greenhouse:airbnb", "https://jobs.lever.co/spotify", "https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite", "stripe.com"]

keyword.description: Keep jobs whose title or description mentions every word of this text

titleKeywords.description: Keep jobs whose title contains any of these phrases, e.g. ["engineer", "developer"]

excludeTitleKeywords.description: Drop jobs whose title contains any of these phrases, e.g. ["senior", "intern"]

location.description: Keep jobs whose location text or city contains this, or whose country matches this name or ISO code

remote.description: Keep only remote jobs when true

department.description: Keep jobs in a department matching this text

employmentTypes.description: Keep jobs of these employment types

postedSince.description: ISO date; keep jobs posted or updated on or after it

postedWithinDays.description: Keep jobs posted or updated in the last N days

withSalary.description: Keep only jobs that publish a salary figure when true

maxJobsPerCompany.description: Cap on jobs returned per company after filtering (default 1000)

maxItems.description: Cap on jobs returned in total across all companies

includeDescription.description: Workday, SmartRecruiters and BambooHR need one extra request per job for the full text; false skips it for a faster list

apps.description: App Store or Google Play URLs, Apple numeric ids (id310633997) or Play package names (com.spotify.music)

languages.description: Google Play language codes. Defaults to ["en"]

maxReviewsPerApp.description: Reviews per app, country and language. Default 100, 0 returns app metadata only

sinceDate.description: ISO date; only reviews on or after it

video.description: YouTube video URL (watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed, live) or 11-character video ID

languages.description: Language codes in priority order, e.g. ["en", "pt-BR"]; a code also matches its regional variants. Defaults to ["en"]

fallbackToAnyLanguage.description: When none of the languages exist, return the video's original-language transcript (languageFallback: true) instead of an error. Defaults to true

translateTo.description: Translate the transcript into this language code when YouTube offers it

format.description: segments = timestamped JSON plus text (default), text = plain text only, srt/vtt = subtitle file

repoName.description: GitHub repository or list of repositories (max 10) in owner/repo format.

question.description: The question to ask about the repository.
